Teleoperated Race Car

The teleoperated race car merges e-sports and motor sports through teleoperation technology.

Project overview

The teleoperated race car merges e-sports and motor sports through teleoperation technology. Imagine being in an arcade with a steering wheel with pedals and each swerve translates to a real vehicle..

Why it matters

These advances may help aid disabled veterans who may want to participate in motorsports.
author: Karmelo Antonio

title: The Paradox of Want
description: A moth that wants the sun, and meets many a curious folk along the way.
pageHtml:
The Paradox of Want

A moth that wants the sun, and meets many a curious folk along the way.

Project overview

The story follows a moth who dreams of reaching the sun, embarking on a journey filled with encounters with various characters who each have their own desires and challenges.

Why it matters

This narrative explores themes of ambition, desire, and the human condition through the metaphor of a moth's pursuit of the sun.
author: Marcus Yuan G. Pelayo

title: Next-Gen Water Filter
description: Affordable and portable water filtration systems designed for rural communities.
pageHtml:
Next-Gen Water Filter

Affordable and portable water filtration systems designed for rural communities.

Project overview

This project focuses on developing innovative water filtration technology that is both cost-effective and easy to use, aiming to provide clean drinking water to underserved rural areas.

Why it matters

Access to clean water is a fundamental human right, and this project seeks to address the global issue of water scarcity and contamination, improving health outcomes and quality of life for affected communities.

title: Community Art Canvas
description: Connecting street artists to revitalize abandoned public spaces with colorful murals.
pageHtml:
Community Art Canvas

Connecting street artists to revitalize abandoned public spaces with colorful murals.

Project overview

This project aims to transform neglected urban areas into vibrant community spaces through collaborative mural projects that celebrate local culture and creativity.

Why it matters

Public art has the power to inspire, unite, and empower communities, fostering a sense of pride and belonging in the neighborhoods where it resides.

title: Open Source Robotics
description: Accessible, 3D-printable robotic prosthetic limbs for people in developing nations.
author: [Author]
pageHtml:
Open Source Robotics

Accessible, 3D-printable robotic prosthetic limbs for people in developing nations.

Project overview

This project aims to make advanced prosthetic technology more accessible and affordable for individuals in developing countries, improving their quality of life and independence.

Why it matters

By providing open-source designs and manufacturing processes, this initiative seeks to democratize access to life-changing medical devices, bridging the gap between developed and developing regions.
